text.description: The text content to display. While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation.

variant.description: A hint for the base text style. Values: `h1` is the largest top-level heading; `h2` is a second-level heading; `h3` is a third-level heading; `h4` is a smaller heading; `h5` is a small heading or subtitle; `caption` is small secondary text; `body` is the default body text.
